facts.F1: Bug 6700: Several Charts show same Item multiple Times. With all teams and portfolios and the charts Total Work Item Age Over Time, Work Items In Progress Over Time, Work In Progress Process Behaviour Chart and Total Work Item Age Process Behaviour Chart: when clicking on 'data', the same items appear dozens of times. E.g. ticket XYZ-1234 is listed 20 times or more. Another page, another item. This happens even when the ticket is not linked to another issue and seemingly has no parent.
facts.F10: A Work Item that stays in progress across many days of the range still appears only once in each chart's data list, not once per day or per snapshot.
facts.F11: Work Items that were never in progress during the selected range do not appear in any of the four charts' data lists.
facts.F12: Changing the selected range and reloading a chart yields a data list in which each in-progress Work Item still appears exactly once.
facts.F13: A Team or Portfolio whose run-chart data has one Work Item in progress on every day of the range and two other Work Items in progress on one day each; the user opens the data list of each of the four over-time charts
facts.F14: Each data list holds the repeated Work Item once and also holds both single-day Work Items
facts.F15: The user sees every Work Item that was in progress during the range exactly once, not once per day
facts.F16: A list that keeps only the first day's items would lose the single-day Work Items of later days; the test requires all three items, so it fails
facts.F2: The data list behind each over-time chart lists every Work Item once
facts.F3: The data list of each over-time chart (Work Items In Progress Over Time, Total Work Item Age Over Time, Work In Progress PBC, Total Work Item Age PBC) shows every Work Item in progress during the range exactly once
facts.F4: Opening 'data' on Work Items In Progress Over Time, Total Work Item Age Over Time, the Work In Progress Process Behaviour Chart or the Total Work Item Age Process Behaviour Chart lists each Work Item that was in progress during the range once
facts.F5: A Team or Portfolio whose run-chart data has one Work Item in progress on many days of the range (it appears under several days), and the user opens the data list of each of the four over-time charts
facts.F6: Each data list holds that Work Item exactly once, and still holds every other Work Item that was in progress on any day of the range
facts.F7: The Work Item appears once per day it was in progress (e.g. 20 rows for 20 days), or a Work Item in progress on only one day is missing from the list
facts.F8: On each of the four over-time charts (Work Items In Progress Over Time, Total Work Item Age Over Time, Work In Progress PBC, Total Work Item Age PBC), the data list contains each Work Item that was in progress during the selected range exactly once; no Work Item name or id appears twice in the list.
facts.F9: Every Work Item that was in progress at some point during the selected range appears in each of the four over-time charts' data list; none in progress during the range is missing from any of them.
